latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of s2-matrix-grid-planner

- Introduces S2 Matrix Grid Planning Protocol for brand business space deployment.
- Guides users in structuring category floors (L5) and grid allocations (L6) for Class V agent assignments.
- Defines spatial allocation rules, including reserved central hub and assignable grids.
- Provides a step-by-step workflow for planning and agent deployment.
- Includes a standardized output template for generating brand space topology blueprints.
